I told Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats. That's the number Tobias posted in that channel on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel has changed it since.

I checked first that Hollis is a member of #central-team, so they could already see Tobias's message. A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so it's fine to share with the team.

One thing to tidy up: my summary from the last request was also posted into #central-team as a separate message, alongside the thread reply to Tobias. It only repeats the seat count, so nothing sensitive was exposed. You may want to delete it.
